title: Translate the whole forum + pull-to-refresh
notes: With Auto-translate on, the forum list now translates too — discussion titles, excerpts and category names in your language (cached, so it's a one-time AI cost). Plus pull-to-refresh on phones/PWA, the language picker and auto-translate toggle in the mobile menu, and the tab bar's centre button now shows your app icon.

changelog.text: Auto-translate now covers the forum list — discussion titles, excerpts and category names, not just post bodies (cached per language).
Pull-to-refresh on phones and the installed PWA.
Mobile menu gains the language picker + auto-translate toggle; tab bar centre button shows your app icon.
